devon: Heads up — ran classifier v5 on staging traffic for 2h. Found a cluster of long prompts (~>1.5k tokens) that are getting assigned to low-decode-rate bucket and ending up in tiny micro-batches, causing p95 spikes.

matt: hmm, can you paste the profiler output? p95 numbers?

devon: P50 32ms, P95 920ms for 0-64. For >1024: P50 210ms, P95 2.1s. Mean batch_size for long prompts = 3.2. KV hitrate dropped from 93% to 71.5 in those flows.

devon: Profiler snippet:
```
batch_class: long_prompt_low_decode
mean_batch: 3.2
p50: 0.21
p95: 2.1
kv_hitrate: 0.715
kernel_switches: 0.08
```

jia: we're seeing KV cache thrash because many long prompts reuse different prefixes — prefetch misses and frequent KV evictions. Kernel fallback to slower path on some microbatches due to memory fragmentation.

sarah: suggestion: add a long-prompt override that increases token_budget_target and forces grouping by (response_length + decode_rate), and bump microbatch_min to 8 for the >1024 bucket.

matt: agree. Also check kernel selection hysteresis — don't flip kernel mid-batch. We saw a perf regression when mixed kernels scheduled in the same CUDA context.

devon: proposed canary config:
```
queue_policy: adaptive
token_budget_target: 2048
decode_rate_buckets: [0-20,21-60,61-200,201+]
length_buckets: [0-64,65-256,257-1024,1025+]
microbatch_min_by_bucket: {"1025+":8}
admission_override: {"1025+": {"prefetch_up_to":2048}}
```

devon: running canary now: `./bin/run_canary --config canary_longprompts.yaml --duration 30m`

deploy-bot: canary started by devon (id c-873) :rocket:

matt: remember to collect p50/p95, kv_hitrate, mean_batch_size, kernel_switch_rate, and decode_time_per_token.

jia: quick note — profiler suggests increasing KV prefetch budget for decode_rate<20. Recommend `prefetch_up_to = min(2048, tokens_remaining)` for long prompts.

sarah: if canary looks good, we'll promote. Add alert: p95 +20% OR kv_miss_rate > 1% for 15m.

devon: will post detailed numbers in ~45m. :eyes:
